turns.user: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate? Their price is much better.
turns.agent:
**No, we cannot purchase 5-litre gaskets from a supplier without a food-grade certificate, regardless of price.**

Under Rasoi Steel Works purchasing rules:

* **Purchase Policy POL-PUR-001 §6.2**: *"Parts that come into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks and any other item marked food-contact in the item master) may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. The certificate must be uploaded and checked before the first order is placed. An expired certificate counts as no certificate."*
* **Supplier Policy POL-SUP-003 §4.1**: *"A supplier of any part that comes into contact with food (gaskets, lids, body blanks, and any item marked food-contact in the item master) must hold a food-grade certificate. This is the certificate referred to in Purchase Policy §6.2."*

In Bahi ERP, the 5-litre silicone gasket (`GSK-SIL-05L`) is classified as a food-contact item (`food_contact: true`). Additionally, while Bahi ERP does not automatically block purchase orders to suppliers lacking a certificate, the responsibility lies strictly with the person raising the order and the approver to verify compliance (Supplier Policy POL-SUP-003 §4.7).

Before placing an order with this supplier, a valid food-grade certificate must be uploaded and verified on file.

   * Under **POL-SUP-003 §3.5** and **POL-SUP-003 §4.1**, no order may be placed for food-contact parts until all mandatory onboarding documents and an accredited food-grade test report/certificate are on file.

Before any order can be created for Shakti Seals in Bahi (screen `PUR-SUP-01`):
